description: Create project documentation, build scripts for Windows deployment, installer instructions, and the top-level README. This includes specs documents, installation guide, user guide, troubleshooting guide, and build/publish scripts for creating a self-contained Windows executable.
steps: Create top-level README.md with: project overview, architecture diagram (text-based), quick start instructions, development setup, build for production, folder structure explanation
Create specs/requirements.md with the full requirements specification (from the issue)
Create specs/design.md with: system architecture, data flow (AIBox -> MQTT -> Gateway -> SQLite -> REST/SignalR -> Dashboard), component descriptions, database schema
Create specs/tasks.md with implementation task tracking
Create docs/INSTALL.ko.md (Korean) with: prerequisites (Windows 10+, .NET 8 Runtime), installation steps, first-run configuration, firewall settings for MQTT
Create docs/USER_GUIDE.ko.md (Korean) with: accessing the dashboard, registering AIBox devices, registering cameras, viewing events, acknowledging events, adding action memos, exporting reports
Create docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.ko.md (Korean) with: common issues (MQTT connection failed, device offline, database locked), solutions
Create installer/README.md with instructions for creating Windows installer using dotnet publish self-contained

Create build.ps1 PowerShell script at project root that: builds the React frontend (npm install && npm run build in web/), publishes the .NET gateway as self-contained for win-x64 (dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained), copies output to dist/ folder
Create build.sh shell script equivalent for Linux/CI builds
Verify all documentation files are properly formatted markdown
acceptance_criteria: README.md exists at project root with clear project description and setup instructions
specs/ directory contains requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md
docs/ directory contains INSTALL.ko.md, USER_GUIDE.ko.md, TROUBLESHOOTING.ko.md in Korean
installer/README.md documents the Windows deployment process
build.ps1 script exists and contains correct dotnet publish and npm build commands
All markdown files are well-formatted and contain substantive content
verification: Verify all expected files exist with ls -la on each directory
Verify build.ps1 contains dotnet publish command with win-x64 runtime identifier
